title: THE REBIRTH OF GOD’S NATION ON THE EARTH

sense.text:
These are perilous times. The whole economy of the whole planet earth is based on the destruction of our people, so the whole earth is rejoicing over our destruction. If we dare to wake up, it puts an end to their rule, their rejoicing, their posterity and their prosperity. That is why they will pull out every slick stop to make sure we never rise, with subtle tactics used to demonize and destroy every relationship we try to keep so that we can be a more perfect nation under God.

“Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them.” The heavens are the nations, those in rulership now, over us. Heaven is glory: that is their kingdom, and they are in it and do not want to lose it. Negroes ain’t dwelling in heaven; we ain’t dwelling in no kind of glory. Those that dwell in them are the devils that dwell in their rulership, oppressing everybody else. Rejoice now, because the Most High is getting ready to jack these heavens up.

“Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea!” The inhabitants of the earth are us, the people in captivity under them. The sea is the nations again: everybody is catching hell up under this beast.

“For the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath.” The Lord is speaking to us, the 12 tribes of Israel, catching hell under this beast. The devil is mad because he is going down.

“Because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.” How does he know? Because he sees the rise of you. You’re the clock. The Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists has its doomsday clock, minutes to midnight, from the Cold War days of Russia and America, fallout shelters and kids running under the tables. But they are not looking at some clock: they are measuring by looking at you. When that clock strikes 12, Christ is coming. Our waking up is a supreme indicator that our Saviour is about to come, get us out of captivity and put them in chains. Things are happening very fast now. That is why they are trying to stop the teaching and calling us a hate group: to turn people’s ears away from what we teach.

precepts.why:
“But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire.” The Lord is going to destroy these heavens; he is going to destroy these kingdoms. “Which are now” means the heavens and earth in existence today, not only in Peter’s time.

“By the same word”: by the same Bible. The kingdoms before were the kingdoms in the time of Noah, when the water overflowed and destroyed them; that is what the chapter is talking about. The same Bible that records the heavens overthrown with water says these heavens will be destroyed by fire. This time fire is going to be used.

“Against the day of judgment”: we are coming up on the day of judgment now, and this administration is showing it in all the things they are doing in the news. That day of judgment is what will bring this fire.

“And perdition of ungodly men.” Perdition means destruction. Brothers and sisters, you do not want to be caught up in the destruction of wicked men, regardless of what they look like. If they are talking foolishness against this Bible, cut them off; leave them in the sandbox till they get some sense. So the heavens that rejoice in Revelation 12:12 are the kingdoms reserved unto fire.

“And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved.” This is not the heaven of the Lord’s prayer, where we ask for his kingdom to come and his will to be done in earth as in heaven: the order of the Most High that we will enjoy on earth. That is totally different from the heaven that is going to be destroyed by fire. Heavens means rulership; captivity is hell, just to make it simple. The host is the rulers of this planet, the same rulers of Revelation 12:12, and they shall be dissolved with destruction.

“And the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll”: their kingdoms are going to be rolled together in a mushroom cloud, when the bombs are dropped that the Lord calls these same people to make. The thumbnails may point at Trump because he is the one rolling in it now, but he is no different from the rest of them. They all speak the same thing; some just say it nicer, but the knives are still going in your back.

“And all their host shall fall down”: all their leaders fall in destruction when the fire from those bombs that Christ himself is bringing comes down. That is the Lord and the weapons of his indignation to destroy the whole land, in Isaiah 13. “As the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree”: that is how easy it will be to take this system down. A little slight wind, boom, and the figs come falling.

Who is doing it? God, not us. That is God’s fight. There are crazy brothers out there talking about getting their weapons and going to do something while their house is out of order. Your ass going to end up dead. You can’t even run your house right. Shut up and sit down before you hurt yourself.

“For my sword shall be bathed in heaven”: in this kingdom’s heaven, their rulership. Christ is bringing his sword to chop up the people in rulership, because his people are not ruling. God’s nation is in captivity up underneath the enemies, and Christ is coming back to kill our enemies and establish the nation of Israel, the kingdom on earth.

“Behold, it shall come down upon Idumea.” Idumea is the white man, the Caucasians, the ones in rulership now. Idumea is the Greek word for Edom. That is why the Bible says that when the righteous are in authority the people rejoice, but when the wicked bear rule everybody mourns: with the wicked ruling, everything is catching hell. “And upon the people of my curse, to judgment”: Edom was cursed to be God’s vessel of destruction. He was made and fashioned that way and he can’t get out of it. No matter what they do, his lot is to receive the judgment of God.

The Lord works with two vessels. The vessel he channels his mercy through is the 12 tribes of Israel: he will show the whole planet how merciful he is by showing it upon us, the blessed ones. His anger he channels through his vessel of wrath, the curse that cannot get out of it. Who has resisted his will, as Romans 9 says? He hardened Pharaoh to resist him so he could destroy him in the presence of everybody, as an example of what he will do to Esau. So we don’t have a choice but to be the righteous; if you don’t want that, he will liquidate you and you will never be seen or heard from again.

That does not make us a hate group. I can go to work and see him in the street: how’s your children doing? The mama sheep teaches the baby sheep, don’t mess with the wolves. To the wolf, that is teaching hate; to the mama sheep, it is teaching her sheep not to be destroyed. We understand there is a purpose for Esau being here. But at this very time he does not want to give up his throne, and that is why the heavens of Revelation 12:12 are rejoicing now and raging.

sense.text:
“The noise of a multitude in the mountains”: the noise of war, of destruction, the noise of Armageddon, the war that will take place in the valley of decision, all for the controversy of Zion. The controversy of Zion is the true Israelites: the lies against you. The Most High is going to plead with everybody because of what they have done to you and me.

Mountains means government, and “a great people” is a whole lot of nations: the UN and all of them. Twenty-five delegates walked out while Netanyahu was trying to corral everybody to back him in murdering innocent people over there, and they said they would not side with him. The Arabs are going to get it too; that is God’s judgment on them. “A tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together”: tumult means they are fighting and arguing about money, embargoes and politics. “The Lord of hosts mustereth the host of the battle”: the Most High is making the nations fight.

“They come from a far country, from the end of heaven”: the nations with their weapons, from the other side of the earth, mad because America robbed them. “Even the Lord, and the weapons of his indignation”: the Lord is coming from the east too, with fire beams out of his hands, and the chariots, the saucers, the ones the naval officials were scared to death of and tried to hide on tons of videos the public knows nothing about.

“To destroy the whole land.” The Lord calls them to build the weapons to their own destruction. Think about that power. You may not want to build it, because you know what it will do; the Lord says build it, and he will make you build a button and make you press the button.

“Howl ye; for the day of the Lord is at hand.” The day of the Lord is at hand, coming with those missiles. The weapon of this man’s destruction is already here, so we ain’t got too much longer; the signs of the times are here. Where are the Christians with the love of Jesus? The Bible says howl. That is a horrible day.

“It shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.” Meanwhile the Christian programs are singing about the Prince of Peace and sweet old love, not knowing what they are singing. The day of the Lord did not come in the time of the Babylonians, so it is crystal clear this is speaking of now: Christ is about to make his debut into this Babylon the Great, where we are now.

“Therefore shall all hands be faint”: when the rulers find out what the day of the Lord is about, their hands will be faint, without ability to stop it from coming. They will be saying, wait a minute, we don’t need this yet, let’s try to stop it. “And every man’s heart shall melt”: their minds will melt down completely when they see the strangeness of the salvation coming to save Israel.

“And they shall be afraid”: they, the Babylonians. Isaiah was literally writing about the Chaldeans of history, who were Ethiopians, black people. But prophetically he is talking about the United States of America; that is the Babylon he is really talking about, Babylon the Great.

“They shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth”: the Most High will bring these catastrophes closer and closer together, skirmishes, rumours and actual events. He is the one mustering the host of the battle.

“Their faces shall be as flames”: their faces shall be red. First they will be afraid, but this lets you know who these Babylonians are.

precepts.why:
The Bible says woe to him that seeketh the day of the Lord: “Woe unto you that desire the day of the Lord! to what end is it for you?” What are you going to get out of this day? That day is only for the Israelites, for the salvation of the 12 tribes of Israel, because we are the ones that need saving. If everybody else is in their heaven and their salvation, what do they need to be saved from?

That shows the potency of the crap called Christianity: the oppressed sitting in church with the oppressor, one with shackles around his mind and the other holding the shackles, both talking about going into the kingdom together. He has the chain on your head, yanking it whenever he feels like it, and you want to go into the kingdom with him.

This day is not for the other nations, and that is why they are trying to stop it. What are they going to get out of it but death and the losing of their kingdom? That is why they are cutting up now: they see you waking up. “The day of the Lord is darkness, and not light”: darkness for everybody except the 12 tribes of Israel that repented. It is not a good day for them. “As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him”: you thought you got away from one thing, and your problems got worse. So when Isaiah says howl, for the day of the Lord is at hand, it is howling for them, not for us.

“Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.” That is what we, the prophets, the sanctified ones, are doing: we are teaching. We lift up the voice and give the warning that the day of the Lord is at hand.

sense.text: “And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency”: that is America, the beauty of her weapons, her technology and all of that. That is how they look at this man. “Shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah”: and God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah with fire coming out of the heavens. This verse proves that the Babylon of Isaiah 13 is Babylon the Great of today.

precepts.why:
How did the Lord destroy Sodom and Gomorrah? “Then the Lord rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven.” That is how Babylon is going to be destroyed: by fire.

Ancient Babylon did not go down that way. The Medes did war and overthrew it; it did not go down with fire. So this is Babylon the Great. There are missiles in silos right now waiting to fulfil what we just read, to hit this place. Who is doing that? God.

Now you understand why they want to shut us up. As the sanctified ones bring us out, the angels activate and make those scientists make more weapons and press the button. That is how powerful you are when you have this Bible.

sense.text: “The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet”: when this bastard devil goes down, the whole earth will be at rest. He is called a bastard because God called him that; that is not hate talk, that is the Bible. He and all the nations are not God’s children; the children of the flesh are not the children of God. The whole earth is mourning because of the wicked; when the wicked ain’t ruling no more, everything will rejoice. “They break forth into singing”: the birds, the animals, everybody is going to be happy because this devil ain’t ruling no more.

“Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.” Since the devil is laid down, all the nations catching hell up under Esau will get out from that oppression for a little season, because they are going into captivity under Israel, but in righteousness.

“Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming.” The condition of hell is being moved away from the nations to meet the white man, Idumea, in his coming down into hell. All of the nations are catching hell; who put the hell on them? Esau. The verses above say he smote the people with a continual stroke: captivity, robbery, embargoes, military, everything, with all the nations trembling because he rules over them. This Bible is heavy.

“It stirreth up the dead for thee”: the hell he put on them made the nations mad and angry and stirred them up to pull this man down into captivity. That is why they are getting weapons. “Even all the chief ones of the earth”: crystal clear, all the rulers of the earth. “It hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations”: all the kings are singularly thinking about getting him. Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his: that is how they are thinking now.

We are in some serious times, and the negro is playing around talking about multiple women. Sisters, wake up. None of you should allow yourselves to be played like that. You don’t know the value of your body. These men have no real ability to take care of you and four other women; in the kingdom with money it would be something different, but nobody is on that level. You’re going to pay for that.

“Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?” The thou is the white man. All the nations will rise up and say, Edom, are you become weak like us, because we are pulling you down into it now. You ain’t bad no more, because we got weapons too.

“Thy pomp is brought down to the grave”: Christianity and all that mess is going down. The noise is that Christian madness; the Most High calls it noise, and all that garbage is coming down. What causes all of this? When the prophet speaks. The words of this Bible are affecting kings and people all over this planet. So yes, there is a target on us, and we don’t give a damn.

“The worm is spread under thee”: corruption. Many of them are corrupt as hell and robbing their own system: embezzlement, scheming, stealing, Enron kind of stuff, robbing each other, because they are greedy like that. “And the worms cover thee”: they are not going to recover. The corroded men are going to rot the whole system down.

“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning!” Fallen from your heaven, your rulership; that word again. Lucifer means light bearer. You said you were the bright star of wisdom, the bright star of justice, telling everybody they have to come to you. You put yourself up like the lady of liberty, the light for everybody to follow. That is what Lucifer is talking about: you’re the devils.

“How art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!” Cut down out of your rulership, out of your heaven. Weakening the nations means you put them in hell. It lets you know who this beast is: the same devil whose heavens rejoice in Revelation 12:12 and who knows he has but a short time.

precepts.why: “The wicked shall be turned into hell.” That is where they are going. The hell that is moved from beneath to meet him at his coming is the hell he put on the nations, and the wicked are turned into it.

sense.text:
Revelation 7 tells you that you are the clock, you men especially. When the last brother of the 144,000 out of every tribe wakes up (and with them the third: the men, the women, the children and the babies God set to redeem out of this captivity), the time is up. This is what they are trying to stop; that is why they call us a hate group, to turn people’s ears away from what we teach.

“I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth.” Keep in mind everything about the kingdoms with bombs and weapons. These are the angels holding back the nations that have nuclear weapons, resting on the minds of the scientists and the people working in those silos. The angel is actually in the control room; he pulls up a chair beside the man with the button. It is not regular wind; wind blows every day. It is the wind of destruction.

“That the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.” The sea is the battleships and the military in the waters: the Lord is saying, I don’t want to destroy the nations yet. The trees, because when the bombs come the trees are going to catch fire, and it shall leave neither root nor branch.

“And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God.” The seal of the living God is the commandments, coming to seal up the 12 tribes of Israel, the 144,000. It is not a six-pointed star; that is demonic. It is the sealing of the commandments in our foreheads: when you learn it and become a changed man, and we are no longer your negro.

“He cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea.” The job of these four angels is to hurt the earth: to sit in the chair beside the bomb master and tell him to press the button.

“Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.” Don’t do it yet. Don’t burn up the trees yet. Do you see the weight of it? That is why we teach the commandments: to seal the law among the Israelites, the 12 tribes of Israel.

The chapter goes on through 12,000 out of every tribe. The 144,000 is not a third of the nation of Israel, and the Lord said he will save a third of Israel. The rest of the nation is recorded in the ninth verse: the men, the women, the children, the scattered, still Israelites, which the dumb churches pervert into all nations.

precepts.why: “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” That is the seal Christ is bringing, the seal the angel from the east carries to seal up the tribes of Israel all over the planet. The seal of the living God is the law, the commandments, sealed among his disciples.

sense.text:
“At that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people”: the Israelites. No other nations are in this.

“And there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time”: that is where we are now. These are troublesome times because, as we read, the devil is come down upon us having great wrath, knowing he has but a short time. He is rough, he is mad, so Michael the archangel and Christ will have to take him out.

“And at that time thy people shall be delivered”: the Israelites, the 12 tribes, those that have repented. That is the day of the Lord, the day of Isaiah 13: howl ye, for the day of the Lord is at hand. See how the scriptures connect.

“And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake.” We have people who passed away in this truth. We are not worried about them, because their good works follow them, and the Most High will bring their spirits up first. We are going to see our brothers and sisters again, Lord willing, as long as we make it. They died in faith, and that is what we want to be, not dying up under some porn site.

“Some to everlasting life”: because they died in Christ. “And some to shame and everlasting contempt”: never to be seen again, because they died in their sins.

“And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.” That is our job: to turn many of you brothers and sisters to righteousness by teaching this truth. Even the sisters caught up in that whoredom can repent, and the brothers with that dumb doctrine in their minds can let that mess go and be saved. All of you have the chance to repent, but you must stop that wicked doctrine or the Most High will kill you. I’m reading the Bible; if you have a problem, take it up with him.

“But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end.” Daniel saw all of this in Babylonian captivity, but it was not for him to deal with then; it was for the time of the end, which is where we are now. “Many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased”: all this information is coming out, prophecy left and right, everybody seeing what is happening. This is not the time to play games.

That is what the rebirth of God’s nation on earth is about: building up our spiritual and mental toughness against sin, which carries over into our physical toughness, the action our God approves.

“For the Lord is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.” You can’t just say be warmed and filled and think things will happen. You have to put action into it. Your faith is demonstrated by your works; faith without works is dead.

We could not just spiritually talk about building schools; we had to actually build them. The schools we have around the globe did not pop out of thin air. Work had to be put in, because we believe in this Bible.

But the works you most have to put in are the works to change yourselves. You can’t say I’m a Christian like they do in church and be just as wicked as Satan himself. You literally have to change into righteousness. Nobody wants to hear talk; show me what you are doing. That is how God measures your faith. And if you don’t change, all those prophecies we just read, the angels, the chariots, the bombs, will hit you too. What good is rejoicing about them then?

“Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.” That is why the title says on earth: the order of heaven is going to be established here, so we had better prime our minds to adjust to what is coming. It is not a choice. When Christ brings you into the bond of the covenant, you do what the Most High said or he has no use for you. He created us to be his ambassadors and representatives of righteousness on this earth. Would you keep a car that don’t run? If it is no longer useful, you get rid of it, and that is what the Lord will do if we don’t get ourselves together. In earth means it is something we have to do on the ground, right now, while we are still around.

This is what the whole class has been explaining. We have to work and build it, and when we do, the Most High will bless our hands, because our faith is demonstrated by our works. That is how the kingdom will be brought in earth. Christ is going to bring it.

“And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.” We have to learn this. That is being in the wilderness, in the tabernacles. Offenses happen in the tabernacles, and we had better find a way to get over them. If something violates the laws, we go to our brother: we are a nation in the wilderness, let’s straighten it out and endeavour to keep the unity, so we can all get the kingdom together.

That is not letting wickedness in. Make the judgments; judge that ass. If you don’t, the Most High will kill the whole camp. You have to get to the bottom of things.

“And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.” Don’t let your lust drive you into something that will get you jacked up. Pray that the Most High takes that lust spirit off of you. Lust is a big thing among Israel. The Bishops have seen it: rolling through the reports, the majority deal with violations of civil and moral laws, primarily adultery and fornication. Study, pray and apply: apply the Lord’s prayer to your life and we would not have these problems.

“For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.” Christ’s kingdom is going to become our kingdom as well, because we are joint heirs with him. Make sure we do the right things so we don’t get left behind, and get on that good old gospel ship.

“And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come”: that is what they were pressing Christ for. “The kingdom of God cometh not with observation”: you can’t just sit back and squeeze your eyes, oh, it’s coming, it’s going to land here. The Most High wants work that demonstrates you deserve it. Who will commit to your trust the true riches? You have to demonstrate that you can handle yourself with righteous behaviour in the kingdom. The Most High doesn’t want you messing his kingdom up with your wickedness.

The best place to practise getting it out is right here, right now. That is why the wilderness and the tabernacles matter: that is the place to iron it out. Before we go into the literal kingdom, we are going through a major tabernacle, recorded in Ezekiel, where he makes us pass under the rod, and the ones that don’t make it will die right there.

“Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there!” That is not how it is going to happen. “For, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.” As a man thinketh in his heart, so is he; as a woman thinketh. That is why you must not let somebody corrupt your mind with foolishness. If we think on the righteous laws of God, nothing can come of that but righteousness. The Most High rides on the crest of righteous thought in your mind; that is where wisdom dwells. In a malicious soul wisdom cannot dwell; his wisdom dwells with a true, clean heart.

The kingdom within us means we must build and fortify all aspects of our nation. There is a mental pain we must be willing to endure to build the physical structure of our nation: hands to paper, hands to bricks, hands to wood. That is why we have the programs we have. It takes a lot to break away from being a negro: comfortable with mediocrity, with being a slouch, fat, out of shape, with a messed-up mind. We can’t be comfortable in that.

The Lord put the mind on top of the body because it is supposed to govern everything below it. You sisters are built with a specialness: God gave you a mind, and it needs to be cultivated by a righteous man, not some man who just wants to play with you. Building our nation is the equivalent of our forefathers building the temple and the wall in the time of Nehemiah, in the midst of our enemies.

“When Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.” Sanballat is our enemy, just to make it simple. Just as he got mad when we built, our enemies today see that we are trying to build and they get mad, wroth just like the dragon, with great wrath and indignation, mocking us.

“What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves?” Look how they talk about us: these feeble Israelites. Will the Lord actually fortify them? Will the Lord actually be with them? That mockery is the kind of talk that will break your confidence down if you listen to it. Sometimes the foolishness comes from BHIs, black people with fringes on, saying something that gets your mind all twisted up. Recognize what you are dealing with, move them out of your way and keep moving forward. We have no hatred for any of them, and hope they repent and get right, but we are not playing games with anybody out here promoting foolishness.

“Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?” The Babylonians had literally burned our temple and destroyed everything. Will these feeble Israelites rebuild the ruins? They are laughing at us.

“If a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.” They are saying we have no skills to build anything, and we end up carrying that and believing that we can’t do what the Lord said we can do. This is what our enemies say about us today.

“Hear, O our God; for we are despised.” This is us making a prayer to the Lord. They are mad that we are being used as prophets and teachers, going out into the streets and all the avenues. Our job is to revive the souls of our people through the blood of Christ, through Israel United in Christ: to give them the breath, as with Adam, as in Ezekiel when the breath came into them and they lived. Our enemies don’t want that.

“Turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity”: like when the brothers pray at the beginning of our classes for destruction upon our enemies. Deacon Malachi does it very heavily, and Captain Suriah; we are praying for vengeance. “And cover not their iniquity”: don’t hide what they did to us; bring it out. “For they have provoked thee to anger before the builders”: our job is to rebuild our nation, and that is what we are doing now.

“So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.” Not just sitting with faith in some corner: work, work, work. You only work for something you believe in. A woman on the table in labour: her faith is wanting to deliver that baby, and her work is the pushing. Faith without works is dead. You envisioned that child in your mind, counting the toes; now push.

Recognize the beauty that goes on when a man and a woman come together to produce a child. That is heavy, and nothing to be playing with.

“When Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up”: brought up to date, they are mad that we got another school, that more people are repenting, that we get stronger every week. We did no harm to anybody. Just the fact that we are changing our evil ways into righteous ways is a threat to them, because they know once we repent God will be on our side and they will not be able to abuse us as they have.

“And that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth.” What are the breaches today? Sin. The first breach that must be stopped is the breach of sin, because that is what separates us from our God. All of us had to repent of our evil ways, and they don’t want us to repent. Thank goodness for Original Royalty, which had to step into that rap, crime and gangster life, the drill music and all that craziness, while Trump is sending the troops in to wipe them out. They know they have a short time left, so they say, just get rid of them.

The majority of our incidents deal with moral and civil violations against each other, primarily fornication and adultery, because of lust. Go not after your lust. This society makes it its permanent business to entice you with racy ads, videos and music, on your jobs and in your schools, and these things lead to the permanent destruction of our people.

So we set up a proving process for brothers and sisters, primarily the younger members: generally three years, as agreed with Deacon Yashua. It is not a biblical law (the elderly may not have three years), but it is respectable: a diligent search, so no skeletons come out as soon as you are married. You should not be driven to marry solely on lust. Marriage is where the real work and the real journey begin, and you are supposed to want to grow old with that person. No backdoor weddings. When it is done right, the bishops, deacons and captains can bless that marriage.

“For I would that all men were even as I myself.” This is Paul: I am so dedicated to the work, I don’t want to deal with women. “But every man hath his proper gift of God, one after this manner, and another after that.” Everyone has his own stamina; some can withhold from that because they want to dedicate their whole work to the Lord. He that has a wife has to care for his wife, but he that is by himself can put all his diligence into the Lord. One has this talent, another that.
“It is good for them if they abide even as I”: good, because they would not have to deal with the cares of a spouse, male or female. But not everybody has that strength, and we understand that.

“But if they cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.” Everybody has heard this one. It means that if a man cannot contain his sexual desires, it is better for him to go through the process of proving and then get married, than to end up burning in lust and dying in the lake of fire. It runs two ways: burning with desire, and the ultimate burn of destruction that comes when fornication comes.

We will all say the right thing, but often the mind is somewhere else: I ain’t waiting years, look at that sister. Get married, but understand what it means. Make sure all the steps are in place so you marry properly. When you marry, you are marrying a daughter of the Lord, not a human condom, which is how some of these women are being treated in other camps.

“Thou madest Adam, and gavest him Eve his wife for an helper and stay: of them came mankind.” When a man and a woman come together, they have the ability to produce gods. That is not some plaything; you can’t have children without a wife. She is not something to run through and treat like garbage. How would a father feel, after all the trouble of raising her up, seeing his daughter treated like a piece of meat?

Of them two came mankind: man and woman have the ability to produce the whole planet. As Officer Eli brought out on the Bible Book of Our Fathers, eight people were on the ark, Noah, his three sons and their wives, and from them the whole earth was peopled. That is how special those women were. Do it right once and righteous sons and daughters come of it: two or three children marry, five or six families become 12, then 24. Women, understand your value. If your camp is not teaching you that, get the hell out; and brothers, if the sisters don’t want the right thing, get up and go, because some women are as nasty as some men.

“It is not good that man should be alone”: that is back to let them marry. “Let us make unto him an aid like unto himself.” When you marry you are looking for an aid that can actually help you, not a jump-off: one who values what you bring and values that family and that child. And you don’t treat her like a piece of meat.

“And now, O Lord, I take not this my sister for lust but uprightly.” Anything outside of what we just read is taking her for lust, and that is exactly what this multiple-women situation is about: whoredom. Uprightly means taking care of her in all the things she needs. A lot of these brothers have no money to take care of anything; we are in captivity. You can’t handle four or five women, and she’s dumb to say he can hold her down. He has no discipline to deal right with her; he’ll go dipping into something else and bring back a disease, with no paperwork, nothing to keep anyone straight.

“Therefore mercifully ordain that we may become aged together.” When you look at that sister you are proving, do you think about her getting grey hairs, getting old with you? The young hot brothers often don’t. As soon as she changes a little, or he does, he ain’t satisfying me, she can’t do it like what I’ve seen on porn, and then they want counsel. We ain’t running that type of mess.

“And she said with him, Amen.” Amen means she is in agreement with you, and you with what you are supposed to do as a married couple. No separation. The father gave you the woman to take care of her: I took care of her as a father, now you pick it up. We don’t want to hear any craziness after all the work her father put in.

“So they slept both that night.” They had a perfect understanding. They were righteously married; he was not taking her for lust but saw her as his helpmeet, to help him make it to old age together. They woke up and praised the Most High, and that was the beginning of their life: a journey together, she on your team.

In that union the family and children come, building a nation together, she your helpmeet and you her guide. Challenges will come, bills and such, but because you came together properly you will help each other through the trial. What God has joined together, let not man, sin, lust for other women, or adultery when age sets in put asunder. Wanting somebody younger is all lust. Every man must have his own wife and every wife her own husband. You are supposed to love what is between her ears more than what is between her legs. A beautiful woman cheers the countenance, but nobody wants a pretty dummy.

precepts.why:
These are the scriptures that tell what she brings to his bones. “The grace of a wife delighteth her husband”: a wife, not a jump-off, not a hoe. “And her discretion will fatten his bones”: she is not stupid. He lights up, he’s happy; she is adding years to his life. That is what you should be thinking about when you look for a wife. You come to her father and ask for her hand, and the father checks you all the way out; if he finds you worthy, you had better take care of her.

“A silent and loving woman is a gift of the Lord.” She is not going to be silent if the bills aren’t paid, or if you are battling four or five women. She may be tricked into thinking she is all right, but inside she is mad as hell. You can’t treat her like garbage.

“And there is nothing so much worth as a mind well instructed.” Ponder that. When you see married men do great things, what do other men say? He must have a good woman behind him: she fattens his bones. Her daddy taught her well, and the people she came up around taught her well. That is what you want by your side, brothers, a wife to grow aged together with.

sense.text:
“For this cause shall a man leave father and mother.” If you are still living in your mama’s house, you should not be thinking about anything on that side of the room. If you have no means of getting your stuff together, you don’t need to be talking to anybody; you had better have some potential. That is why we give the brothers the third degree: we are not making hoes out of our women. She is no bed wench.

“And shall cleave to his wife”: did it say cleave to his wife until she’s 35 and then stop? “And they twain shall be one flesh”: the two of them one flesh until death do them part. When people love each other properly, they stay beautiful. You can see age on a woman and it is beautiful, the grey, the wisdom emanating from her. That does not come cheap; it took work to build that kind of woman, and that kind of brother. And a good woman who gets a man with wisdom, who can really teach her something, will value him the rest of her days.

“Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh.” That is how they have to think: two together make one. “What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder”: let not sin put it asunder, nor your lust and temptations break your marriage, because when you married it was till death do you part. We often don’t understand the seriousness of this institution called marriage.

“Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery.” Except it be for fornication: there are brothers who hate the wife and try to force her to leave. She can’t marry anybody but the man she first married, and he can’t leave her. There ain’t no divorce with the Most High. If she is nasty as hell, you are free: do the right thing and get properly remarried. But some brothers just don’t like her anymore and start making up uncleanness to get rid of her, as in Deuteronomy 24, and because of the hardness of their hearts Moses had to put negro-proof laws in.

Understand all the work required as a husband and as a father to keep your house in proper order. A lot of men just want to dip and dab and run: I ain’t got no papers on her. You got papers on your car, a driver’s license, papers on everything, but you tell the woman you don’t need papers on her.

“And whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.” She cannot play games with this marriage. Through her father she must make sure whoever she marries, this is it. That takes time. People are young for a short time compared to the span of their life, and some mess their lives up in the first fifth of it and pay for it the rest of their lives: five children from a knucklehead, diseases, because no father, no brothers, no righteous congregation taught them how to protect what God gave them sacredly. God put your private parts in a private place, covered with clothes and a solid mind; a man is not supposed to have access because he blew in your ear. That is what men do. When a man gets a wife he gets a possession: his family, and as men we are in charge of everybody. Men are responsible: whenever things are not right it is our duty to bring you back into the proper mindset before you hurt yourself.

“His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.” It is that serious. As a husband you have to handle all of it: the craziness, the arguments. You can’t run away like a hobo or say I can’t deal with it anymore. If you are not ready for that, leave that woman alone, because she is not a plaything. It is a terrible thing to see women not know their value and get treated like garbage. As leaders of the people we must pay serious attention to the sins attempting to overthrow our efforts to build our way toward the kingdom, and give the medicine God wants us to give to heal the whole nation.

“And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.” That is what our enemies want to do: give us all kinds of innuendos, lies and slander, anything to break the brotherhood and the sisterhood, to break the unity and dissolve the bands, and have us loose, wild and crazy, tied up in all types of evil.

We are attacked with every sinful temptation: lust, drugs, music, movies, anything to knock you off course. Much of it is designed to get inside the woman’s head so she does not think righteously about getting a husband: videos to get her all hot, when she does not know how to get a husband. That is not something negative about the woman; it is a slur against us as men. Where was your father, sister? Where were the men in your community? We have to take ownership. Even with Eve, the Lord did not let Adam off: it was that woman you gave me, and it was still Adam’s fault.

Look at how they hinder us. Pfizer sells Depo-Provera, a birth control injection every three months, with side effects of irregular bleeding, weight gain, headaches, mood changes and loss of bone density. Black women take it at nearly double the national rate, and women who took it are suing over brain tumours. The European Union added a warning in 2024 and Canada since 2006, but no such warning was given in the United States, knowing half its users were black women. Black people are supposed to be 13% of the population, yet black women use about half of this product. One woman took it for nearly 30 years, with no husband in sight, and ended up with a tumour on her brain. Pfizer says the FDA rejected its effort to warn patients; either way, they knew half their users were black women and told them nothing. And whether the drug is right or wrong, it should not even be in your vocabulary: no married couple should be dealing with this.

The FDA also quietly approved a second generic abortion pill just before the government shutdown, the way the abortion clinics stayed open, fully staffed, through the COVID shutdown while everything else closed and the COVID babies came. That is the thought planted in a simple woman: I can fornicate and not worry, take this drug or go to the abortionist and do it again. Nineteen million babies destroyed since ’73. The Lord calls that fornication. If you’re not married, keep your legs closed; get a husband. Why would a married woman be taking something like this? Many of the BHI sisters in these multiple-wife situations take it because the brother cannot take care of five or six of them.

In the hospitals our people come in wanting the pill to kill the baby, fighting on the maternity floor, while Esau goes to fertility clinics to have children, and the whole waiting room rejoices when the baby is born. One baby comes home to hatred and chaos, the other to a loving family.

Let every wife have her own husband and every husband his own wife: there is a man for every woman, whatever statistic they bring. The seven women of Isaiah 4 is for when we get out of here, because so many men will be killed in the war; it is no lust trip either. In captivity, deal with it with paperwork: you have papers on your car and your house, so get the papers that say you and your wife belong together.

These are real enemies. The book The Choice, on the issue of black survival in America, records research from October 1968, 1,176 interviews with a national sample of adult Americans, made for the National Commission on the Causes and Prevention of Violence for the Office of Naval Research: only 18% would protest, even nonviolently, the mass repression of American blacks, and only 9% would resist it. People don’t care about us, and that is why we have to deal with ourselves.

Now they speak of using the dangerous cities as training grounds for the military; Washington, D.C. was the testing ground for the rest. They are going into Chicago, and over 30,000 Ukrainian refugees have been brought into Chicago while they get rid of blacks out of it: that is ethnic cleansing. They are serious about what they are doing, and so we must build the wall, stop the breaches of sin, and keep the unity.
